run.error: RuntimeError("paper-comparison benchmark requires 'NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB', observed 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090'")

root_cause: The A100-only benchmark configuration was intentionally executed on an RTX 4090. Model, checkpoint, manifest, environment, and clean-worktree checks passed; the explicit GPU-name guard then rejected the hardware before warmup or measurement.
impact: No scientific metric was produced and no existing result was overwritten. The failed directory is retained as required evidence.
resolution: Keep the A100 entrypoint unchanged and add a separate RTX 4090 hardware-mismatched benchmark configuration and wrapper.
outer_preflight_note: The pasted outer-shell preflight contained torch.**version**, which is invalid Python. It was outside the audited wrapper and the shell continued; it did not cause the recorded wrapper failure. Future commands use python -c with torch.__version__ and do not end by exiting the interactive shell.
